name: RadioGroup
description: One choice from a few visible options. Arrow keys move and select; Tab leaves the group.
signature: <V extends string = string>({ legend, variant, orientation, invalid, tone, className, children, ...rest }: RadioGroupProps<V>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: legend
props.description: Names the group (a fieldset legend in the field-label style).

props.name: orientation
props.description: Direction of layout and keyboard navigation.

props.name: tone
props.description: Tone for every option in the group.

props.name: variant
props.description: list: rows of radios. cards: RadioCard tiles that reflow by container width.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The uncontrolled value of the radio button that should be initially selected.

To render a controlled radio group, use the `value` prop instead.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: form
props.description:
Identifies the form that owns the radio inputs.
Useful when the radio group is rendered outside the form.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: A ref to access the hidden input element.

props.name: name
props.description: Identifies the field when a form is submitted.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback fired when the value changes.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the user should be unable to select a different radio button in the group.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the user must choose a value before submitting a form.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: value
props.description:
The controlled value of the radio item that should be currently selected.

To render an uncontrolled radio group, use the `defaultValue` prop instead.
